- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:250-255 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The tab-delimited summary loses an empty `failing_step` field because tab is IFS whitespace, shifting `log_file` into the wrong column.
  WHY: The diagnosis prompt displays data under the wrong headers and omits log content.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:253 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Job selection excludes review/autofix runs that conclude successfully even when a marker records the failure.
  WHY: The intake reads no linked run or sliced review-job log, leaving the diagnosis agent without evidence.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:856-864 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Self-repo autofix failures unconditionally target the PR head branch instead of the branch the support scripts came from.
  WHY: Fixes can land on dead-end PR branches and never reach the default line.
- Scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:missing entirely | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The evidence bundle script referenced by clarify.yml, plan.yml, and implement.yml is missing from the checkout.
  WHY: The evidence collection steps will fail with command not found or script not found, and sliced logs will not reach the agents.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:892-950 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The literal-loop counter helper and its exemption are absent from the guard.
  WHY: Literal-ID read loops such as `for r in 1 2; do gh api repos/o/r/actions/runs/$r/jobs; done` trigger an unquoted-expansion ask instead of being allowed, stopping unattended sessions on permission prompts.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513-1560; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513-1561 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root and template guard copies differ, including in the unquoted-expansion handling and `_ECHO_READ_HINT` logic.
  WHY: `test_template_parity` compares the files byte-for-byte and fails; reviewers report the required CI check failing with 1 failed, 348 passed.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:staging loop | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The clarify staging loop lacks the declared evidence-script entries, while the PR description says the evidence step uses `GH_TOKEN=secrets.GH_PAT` with `continue-on-error:true`.
  WHY: The step is absent from the current checkout, so the reviewer reports no runtime failure from that step.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:929-937 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No runtime defect is reported; the registry check correctly restricts reads to registered consumer repositories.
  WHY: Clearing `ctx["source_repo"]` when the registry is unavailable prevents an editable `source=` marker from directing `GH_PAT` reads to arbitrary or unregistered repositories.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:827-845 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_support_ref_branch` does not handle literal `main` or `refs/heads/main` values for `script_ref`.
  WHY: If an unresolved ref name is passed, the function returns empty and the fix targets default `stable` rather than `main`; the reviewer notes this is unlikely because the reporter sends a resolved SHA.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
